generator: Hunyuan3D 3.1 Pro image to 3D, through fal (fal-ai/hunyuan-3d/v3.1/pro/image-to-3d), geometry only, 300,000 faces, from four views: the right side as its front, the left side as its back, the top and the bottom
terms: A paid generation: fal lists the model for commercial use, and its terms leave output content to the customer.
note: All four inputs are our own: shaded orthographic renders of the F-16 measured from Marek Cel's CC0 three-view (right side, left side and top; the bottom from the first skinned model, which matches it to a few centimetres). Only views whose longest side is the airframe's length go in: the generator scales each view to fill it, so a nose-on view would read its span as its length.
